title: Extracting a block from concatenated lists
statement: Let $k,m,n,c$ be natural numbers and let $f$ assign a list to each natural number. Suppose every list $f(z)$ has length $k$ whenever $z<m+n+c$. From the concatenation of $f(0),\ldots,f(m+n+c-1)$, discard the first $mk$ entries and retain the next $nk$ entries. The resulting list is the concatenation of $f(m),\ldots,f(m+n-1)$.
